name: lingmind
description: Use project-scoped LingMind business, user, role, and permission queries plus authorized operations through Phoenix MCP.

interface.longDescription: Use one LingMind business environment through Phoenix's explicit CapabilityRegistry. Resolve project context; query business records, users, roles, and the active permission catalog within the logged-in user's effective access; operate jobs, missions, waylines, media, streams, UAV, NVR, robots, and devices; generate daily business reports; and use plan/confirm/execute for destructive or physical actions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the active incidents in my LingMind project
List the users and roles I am authorized to view in my LingMind project
Generate a wayline and prepare a mission action plan
